title: Fishieishie's Modpack
description: Made this for the gang! Has some unique mods liks dinosaurs, furniture, and more stuff to the end!
body:
This modpack was designed to work well for people with different interests. There's a variety of included mods that function for purposes such as making the game more complex (i.e, more gameplay with the end, more biome explorarion) or making the game more entertaining in terms of building (i.e, furniture mods). This modpack includes Architectury API, Biomes O' Plenty, Cloth Config API, End Remastered, Explorations, Fabric API, Farmer's Delight Expansion, Farmer's Delight Refabricated, Forge Config API Port, Fossils and Archeology: Revival, Geckolib, GlitchCore, Macaw's Furniture, Moonlight Lib, More Hitboxes, Sophisticated Backpacks (Unoffical Fabric port), More Hitboxes, Sophisticated Core (Unofficial Fabric port), Spelunkery, 
TerraBlender, and YUNG's API. All credits to those who initially made these mods; My intention was to put these mods in a modpack together as I believe they will function nicely as a group.
